product_of_the_day.label: Product of the Day
product_of_the_day.brief: Introduce today's hero piece with a confident, editorial tone. Explain in one or two lines why it stands out.

todays_pick.label: Today's Pick
todays_pick.brief: A punchy, hype-but-tasteful pick of the day. Keep it short and energetic.

how_to_style_it.label: How to Style It
how_to_style_it.brief: Give 2-3 concrete styling tips: how to wear this piece and what to pair it with.

brand_spotlight.label: Brand Spotlight
brand_spotlight.brief: Put the brand in the spotlight: its aesthetic and why it matters, using this piece as the example.

best_value_find.label: Best Value Find
best_value_find.brief: Frame this as a smart, high-value find. Emphasize the quality-to-price ratio without sounding cheap.

accessory_of_the_week.label: Accessory of the Week
accessory_of_the_week.brief: Highlight this accessory as the detail that completes a fit.
